issue.title: [auth-v1 02/08] Implement login, session verification, and independent revocation (#140)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #347

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed branch `bb/relay-140-auth-v1-02-08-implement-login-session-thr_x9sbe498q2` to origin.

## Summary

Implements issue #140: email/password login, session verification, logout, and independent remote session revocation for Semprec's `semprec-api` service, building on #139's auth schema and cryptographic primitives (rebased onto the latest `develop`, which had merged #139 after this worktree's branch point).

**`backend/packages/data`** (business logic):
- `errors.ts`: `UnauthorizedError` (401, generic message) reused for every login/session failure so no response reveals which condition applied.
- `auth/sessionsStore.ts`: `revokeSessionForUser`, an ownership-scoped revoke.
- `auth/authActions.ts` (new): `login` (Argon2id verify with timing-normalized dummy-hash comparison for unknown emails, one new session per call, records every attempt), `verifySessionToken` (hash → active-session lookup → `last_seen_at` bump), `logout` (revoke caller's own session), `revokeUserSession` (remote revoke of another of the same user's sessions, scoped by ownership).

**`backend/services/semprec-api`** (HTTP surface):
- `authHandler.ts` (new): `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/logout`, `POST /api/auth/sessions/:id/revoke`, `GET /api/auth/session`, plus the exported `authenticateRequest` middleware (accepts either the `semprec_session` cookie or `Authorization: Bearer`) that #143 can reuse for route-wide adoption.
- Wired into `serve.ts`'s path dispatcher.

**Tests**: new `authActions.test.ts` and `authHandler.test.ts` covering successful/failed login, cross-device session independence, cookie- and bearer-based verification, logout scoping, and cross-user revoke rejection.

**Verification**: full build, lint, format check, dependency-boundary check, and the complete test suite (unit 97/97, integration 710/711, e2e 5/5) all pass. The one integration failure was a pre-existing, unrelated flaky concurrency test (`propertyTypeMigration.test.ts`) that passed cleanly on repeated runs and touches none of this issue's files.

This issue was resolved by #347, which just merged into develop.
